hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Northern Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea, Gulf of Bothnia, Kattegat, and Skagerrak, between Finland and Norway || mostly flat or gently rolling lowlands; mountains in west || strategic location along Danish Straits linking Baltic and North Seas; Sweden has almost 100,000 lakes, the largest of which, Vanern, is the third-largest in Europe || Resources: iron ore, copper, lead, zinc, gold, silver, tungsten, uranium, arsenic, feldspar, timber, hydropower || Exports: cars, refined petroleum, packaged medicine, paper, vehicle parts/accessories (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat or gently rolling lowlands; mountains in west || Northern Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea, Gulf of Bothnia, Kattegat, and Skagerrak, between Finland and Norway

climate.excerpt: temperate in south with cold, cloudy winters and cool, partly cloudy summers; subarctic in north || ice floes in the surrounding waters, especially in the Gulf of Bothnia, can interfere with maritime traffic

economy.excerpt: high-income, largest Nordic economy; EU member but does not use the euro; export-oriented, led by automotive, electronics, machinery, and pharmaceuticals; highly ranked for competitiveness, R&D investments and governance; recovery, with falling inflation and real wage growth balanced by risks from trade uncertainty || Exports: cars, refined petroleum, packaged medicine, paper, vehicle parts/accessories (2023) || Industries: iron and steel, precision equipment (bearings, radio and telephone parts, armaments), wood pulp and paper products, processed foods, motor vehicles
